signal: Both Devon and Coterra shareholders approved the transformative merger on May 4, 2026, with the transaction expected to close on or around May 7, 2026
story_fr: Devon et Coterra Energy ont fait approuver leur fusion par les actionnaires des deux societes le 4 mai 2026, transaction attendue vers le 7 mai 2026, creant un operateur de schiste large-cap de premier plan.
story_en: Devon and Coterra shareholders approved the transformative merger on May 4, 2026, with the transaction expected to close on or around May 7, 2026, creating a premier large-cap shale operator.

signal: Projected to reach 100 percent of the $1 billion annual pre-tax free cash flow improvement target well ahead of schedule
story_fr: Devon va atteindre 100% de sa cible d'amelioration de free cash flow avant impots de 1 milliard de dollars par an, bien en avance sur le calendrier, apres avoir atteint 85% en 2025.
story_en: Devon is projected to reach 100 percent of the $1 billion annual pre-tax free cash flow improvement target well ahead of schedule, after achieving 85 percent of the target in 2025.

signal: Acquired approximately 60 net locations in the Delaware Basin for $168 million through lease acquisitions
story_fr: Devon a acquis environ 60 emplacements nets dans le Delaware Basin pour 168 millions de dollars via des acquisitions de baux au troisieme trimestre 2025, renforcant son inventaire de forage.
story_en: Devon acquired approximately 60 net locations in the Delaware Basin for $168 million through lease acquisitions in Q3 2025, strengthening its drilling inventory.

signal: Announced two marketing agreements: an LNG export contract with international pricing exposure and a Permian gas sale tied to power pricing, enhancing portfolio diversification
story_fr: Devon a annonce deux accords de commercialisation : un contrat d'export de LNG a exposition prix internationale et une vente de gaz du Permian indexee sur le prix de l'electricite, diversifiant son portefeuille.
story_en: Devon announced two marketing agreements: an LNG export contract with international pricing exposure and a Permian gas sale tied to power pricing, enhancing portfolio diversification.
